content: Hello, this is Alex Thompson from Amazon Security. We're contacting you today regarding your Prime account. We've detected an unusual renewal charge attempted on your account.
Oh no, I didn't authorize any renewal. My son sometimes uses my account, could he have done something?
I understand your concern. For your security, I want to assure you we're here to help. We need to verify the activity so we can prevent any unauthorized charges or account lockouts.
Please, I just want to make sure my account is safe and that no one else is buying things with it.
Absolutely, your safety is our priority. To proceed, could you please confirm the full name registered to your Amazon account and your best callback number?
Sure, it's Linda Martinez and my number is 555-219-0438.
Thank you, Linda. For security, could you verify the last four digits of your payment card on file? This will allow us to confirm we're securing the correct account.
Let me check... it's 7342.
Perfect, that matches our records. Now, I can see a $129.99 Prime renewal is pending. If this wasn't authorized, I can initiate a cancellation and refund right now.
Yes, please cancel it. I don't want to pay for that.
Of course. To process the refund, our system requires a secure verification. Are you near your computer or mobile device to complete the process?
Yes, I'm on my laptop right now.
Great. For your protection, we use a secure transaction app. Do you have Zelle set up with your bank?
I think so, I have it on my phone.
Excellent. I'm going to walk you through the steps. First, please log in to your banking app and open Zelle.
Okay, it's open.
Now, to verify your account for the cancellation, you'll need to send a refundable transaction. Enter the following Zelle email: customer.refund-amz@outlook.com.
Alright, entered. How much do I send?
Please enter $129.99, matching the pending charge. This step is for verification only, the amount will be immediately refunded back.
Are you sure this is safe? I don't want to lose money.
Absolutely, Linda. This is Amazon's verified process, and I'm here with you throughout. As soon as the transaction is complete, you'll get the full amount back, and your account will be secured.
Okay, I just sent it. What happens next?
Thank you. I'm processing the cancellation now. For confirmation, could you provide the transaction reference number from your Zelle app?
Yes, it's ZL2024-6738.

Received. Your account will be unlocked and the refund processed within 10 minutes. If you see any further notifications, please contact us immediately. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, that's all. Thank you for your help, I was really worried.
You're welcome, Linda. Thank you for confirming your details and following our secure process. Have a safe day.
